input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature, four short splayed legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, root tendrils and wet mist. Chunky artillery silhouette; intact non-gory creature. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, SIXTEEN complete isolated poses. Keys 1-4: four subtle ready IDLE poses with breathing and small natural shifts. Keys 5-10: Six distinct natural frog hopping keys: crouch; hind legs extend to push; body travels forward legs extended; legs tuck under airborne body; front feet contact; hind feet settle into crouch. No human running. Keys 11-16: six ATTACK poses, ready, turquoise throat inflates, head draws back, mouth opens to project forward, throat deflates, ready recovery; no projectile in this body sheet. All complete bodies same anatomical scale, very wide empty magenta gutters. No labels, no text, no anatomy outside its cell. No falling or resting poses. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt: A 4x4 sprite sheet grid of 16 complete isolated animation poses on a solid uniform vivid magenta background (#FF00FF). Hand-painted 2D game character animation sheet. Character identity and art style matching the references: Mire Maw, a broad squat amphibian bog creature with four short splayed legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous glowing turquoise throat sac, root tendrils, chunky artillery silhouette. Intact non-gory creature, purely animal anatomy (no humanoid features, no clothes, no weapons, no gear). Elevated 55-degree orthographic view, front-right three-quarter perspective facing diagonally towards viewer and image-right consistently across all 16 poses. Arranged in a strict 4x4 grid (4 columns, 4 rows) with wide empty magenta gutters between cells. Each cell contains one complete creature at identical anatomical scale within the middle 60% of the cell, no overlapping cells or clipped anatomy. Poses 1-4 (Idle): subtle breathing and natural shifts. Poses 5-10 (Hop cycle): crouch, hind push, airborne leap forward, legs tucking, front feet landing, hind feet settling into crouch. Poses 11-16 (Spit attack): ready, turquoise throat inflates large, head recoils back, mouth opens wide projecting forward, throat deflates, return to ready. Solid flat magenta background, no ground shadows, no grid borders, no text.
